topic: Differentiating a Solute from a Solvent
key_concepts: A solution forms when one substance dissolves into another
A solution is a homogeneous mixture
A solute is the substance being dissolved
A solvent is the substance that does the dissolving
The solute is present in a smaller amount
The solvent is present in a larger amount
Water is called the universal solvent because it dissolves more substances than any other
Soluble substances can dissolve in a solvent
Insoluble substances cannot dissolve in a solvent
Sugar and salt are soluble in water
Oil and enamel paint are insoluble in water
Coffee powder and milk powder dissolve in hot water
